#!/usr/bin/env bash
# .husky/pre-push
#
# Four responsibilities:
#
#   1. SCHEMA DRIFT GUARD
#      Runs drizzle-kit generate to detect whether any schema changes in the
#      unpushed commits lack a corresponding migration file. Blocks the push
#      if drift is found.
#
#   2. JOURNAL INTEGRITY CHECK
#      Runs drizzle-kit check (static — no DB connection required) to confirm
#      the snapshot JSON and SQL are internally consistent.
#
#   3. TYPESCRIPT TYPE-CHECK
#      Runs tsc --noEmit to catch type errors (e.g. invalid StatusPillColor
#      values) before they reach CI. Bypass with SKIP_TYPECHECK=1.
#
#   4. NEON PREVIEW BRANCH TEARDOWN
#      Detects branch deletions (`git push origin --delete <branch>`) and
#      tears down the corresponding Neon preview branch automatically.
#
# ── Emergency bypass ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# If you need to skip the migration checks (e.g. fixing a broken hook itself),
# set SKIP_MIGRATION_CHECK=1 before pushing. This is logged locally so there
# is an audit trail. The CI migration-check and migration-smoke-test jobs will
# still catch any real drift before merge.
#
#   SKIP_MIGRATION_CHECK=1 git push
#
# Note: git push --no-verify skips ALL hooks (including Neon teardown). Prefer
# SKIP_MIGRATION_CHECK=1 so the Neon teardown still runs on branch deletion.

REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ".")
ZERO="0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"

# ── 1 & 2. Schema drift guard + journal integrity check ──────────────────────

CURRENT_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo "HEAD")

# ── Emergency bypass with audit log ──────────────────────────────────────────
if [ "${SKIP_MIGRATION_CHECK:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  GIT_USER=$(git config user.email 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
  TIMESTAMP=$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')
  LOG_FILE="${REPO_ROOT}/.git/migration-check-bypasses.log"
  echo "${TIMESTAMP} | ${GIT_USER} | branch: ${CURRENT_BRANCH} | SKIP_MIGRATION_CHECK=1" >> "$LOG_FILE"
  echo "⚠️  SKIP_MIGRATION_CHECK=1 — migration checks bypassed by ${GIT_USER} at ${TIMESTAMP}"
  echo "   Bypass logged to .git/migration-check-bypasses.log"
  echo "   CI migration-check and smoke-test jobs will still enforce correctness."
else
  # Determine the commit range being pushed.
  REMOTE_REF="refs/remotes/origin/${CURRENT_BRANCH}"
  if git rev-parse --verify "$REMOTE_REF" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    RANGE="origin/${CURRENT_BRANCH}..HEAD"
  else
    # New branch — compare vs the nearest common ancestor with main/dev
    BASE=$(git merge-base HEAD "origin/main" 2>/dev/null \
        || git merge-base HEAD "origin/dev" 2>/dev/null \
        || git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD)
    RANGE="${BASE}..HEAD"
  fi

  SCHEMA_CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only "$RANGE" 2>/dev/null | grep "^src/lib/schema/" || true)

  if [ -n "$SCHEMA_CHANGED" ]; then
    # ── Schema drift check via drizzle-kit generate ─────────────────────────
    #
    # Cleanup strategy: snapshot drizzle/ before the probe runs, then diff
    # afterwards to delete ONLY files drizzle-kit created on this run.
    #
    # A naive `rm -f drizzle/*_pre_push_check.sql` glob silently deletes the
    # four legacy committed sentinel stubs from PR #965
    # (0036__pre_push_check.sql, 0050_, 0057_, 0067_). That happened on
    # 2026-04-24 (b9e2074d → reverted in b1368889). Snapshot-diff avoids it.
    #
    # Journal handling: we back up _journal.json before the probe and restore
    # it afterwards. This preserves any legitimately staged journal changes
    # in the push — a blanket `git checkout -- drizzle/meta/_journal.json`
    # would discard them.
    PROBE_SNAPSHOT_BEFORE=$(mktemp)
    find drizzle -type f 2>/dev/null | sort > "$PROBE_SNAPSHOT_BEFORE"
    PROBE_JOURNAL_BACKUP=$(mktemp)
    cp drizzle/meta/_journal.json "$PROBE_JOURNAL_BACKUP" 2>/dev/null || true

    cleanup_probe_artifacts() {
      local after_files
      after_files=$(mktemp)
      find drizzle -type f 2>/dev/null | sort > "$after_files"
      # Delete anything that didn't exist before the probe ran.
      comm -13 "$PROBE_SNAPSHOT_BEFORE" "$after_files" | while IFS= read -r f; do
        [ -n "$f" ] && rm -f "$f"
      done
      rm -f "$after_files"
      # Restore journal to the exact pre-probe state (preserves staged edits).
      if [ -s "$PROBE_JOURNAL_BACKUP" ]; then
        cp "$PROBE_JOURNAL_BACKUP" drizzle/meta/_journal.json
      fi
      rm -f "$PROBE_SNAPSHOT_BEFORE" "$PROBE_JOURNAL_BACKUP"
    }
